beekeeper.criticalReason: The opaque veil side panel cuts into the left cheek with a ragged edge in the three-quarter view.
beekeeper.summary: The model is the same cheerful beekeeper with a wide hat, a bee, yellow gloves, brown boots, and a honey pot with a dipper. The veil is an opaque cream drum that hangs to the shoulders, and it hides the hair and changes the head silhouette.
strengths: The face reads well: large brown eyes, blush, and a small closed smile match the mockup.
The wide cream hat with a brown band and a bee on top matches the mockup.
The yellow gloves hold the honey pot firmly, and the dipper adds a clear role prop.
The brown boots and the cream suit give the correct palette.
issues: The veil is a solid, opaque cream cylinder under the brim. The mockup shows a see-through net that is pushed back over the hair. Make the veil a thin, light net that sits up around the crown.
The veil side panel cuts into the left cheek, and the lower edge of the veil is ragged. Move the panel away from the face and smooth the edge.
The veil hides almost all of the blonde hair. The mockup shows full, wavy blonde hair at the sides and back. Show more hair.
A dark patch shows under the veil at the back of the neck in the side and back views.
The suit is near white. The mockup suit is a warm tan cream. Warm the suit color.
From the side and the back, the hat and the veil make one large block. At 128 px the hat covers most of the sprite in the north directions.
beekeeper.next: Replace the opaque veil drum with a light net that is pushed back around the hat crown, and show the blonde hair below it.

jeweler.summary: The model is the same bearded jeweler with a gold monocle, a purple vest with gold chains, a magnifying glass with a blue gem, and an open red ring box. The expression is a thin closed smile, and the mockup shows a wide open grin.
strengths: The gold monocle on the left eye, the magnifier with a blue gem, and the open ring box with a ring match the mockup.
The purple vest with gold chains, the white shirt, the belt with a gold buckle, and the black shoes match the mockup palette.
Both held items touch the fists and point the correct way.
The silhouette reads from every view, and the magnifier makes the role clear at 128 px.
issues: The mouth is a thin closed smile. The mockup shows a wide, delighted open smile with teeth. Open the mouth under the mustache.
The beard is thick and covers most of the lower face. The mockup beard is shorter and trimmed along the jaw. Make the beard thinner so the smile shows.
The nose is a large pink bulb, and the mustache curls sit on its sides. Make the nose smaller and set the mustache below it.
The hair is a tall, glossy helmet. The mockup hair is a combed-back pompadour with softer volume and grey sides. Lower the hair and reduce the gloss.
The vest has a quilted pattern. The mockup vest is plain velvet.
jeweler.next: Open the mouth into a wide grin and thin the beard so the delighted expression of the mockup reads.

musician.summary: The model is the same joyful red-haired street musician with a green feathered beret, a red striped vest, a brown skirt, striped socks, and a wooden fiddle. The fiddle is held across the chest, and the mockup shows it under the chin on the shoulder.
strengths: The face reads well: large brown eyes, blush, and a closed smile match the mockup.
The green beret with feathers, the red vest with gold stripes, the brown skirt, the red and white socks, and the brown boots match the mockup palette.
The bow and the fiddle stay in the hands and point the correct way.
The hair stays below the beret in every view.
issues: The fiddle is horizontal at chest height. The mockup shows the fiddle on the left shoulder under the chin. Raise the fiddle to the shoulder and tilt it down.
The hair is shoulder length and chunky. The mockup hair is long and wavy to the waist. Make the hair longer with more waves.
In the three-quarter view the long fiddle neck and the straight bow look like a crossbow. A fiddle at the shoulder makes the instrument read better.
The feathers are orange and white. The mockup feathers are cream and tan.
musician.next: Raise the fiddle to the left shoulder under the chin, as in the mockup.

riverboat-captain.summary: The model is the jolly riverboat captain of the mockup: a navy cap with an anchor, a white beard, an open grin, a navy coat with gold buttons, a white belt, a brass spyglass, and one hand on the hip. The body is less round than the mockup.
strengths: The open grin with teeth, the white beard, and the white eyebrows match the mockup expression.
The navy cap with a gold anchor and a black visor matches the mockup.
The spyglass sits in the fist and points out, and the other fist sits on the hip as in the mockup.
The navy, black, white, and gold palette matches the mockup, and the identity reads in all 8 sprite directions.
issues: The body is only a little round. The mockup shows a wide pot belly and broad shoulders. Make the belly and the coat wider.
The coat is short. The mockup coat is long and open to the thighs. Make the coat longer.
The nose is small and pink. The mockup nose is large and red. Make the nose larger and redder.
The trousers are black. The mockup trousers are dark grey.
riverboat-captain.next: Make the belly and the coat wider so the round, jolly body of the mockup reads.

general.summary: The model is the kind old general of the mockup: a black dome hat with a star and a white plume, grey hair, large ears, a red coat with gold epaulettes, a blue sash, and a brass telescope. The hat is taller than the mockup hat, and the coat is shorter.
strengths: The closed smile, the grey eyebrows, and the large ears match the mockup face.
The red coat, the gold epaulettes, the blue sash, the cream waistcoat with gold buttons, and the black boots match the mockup palette.
The telescope sits in the fist and points out to the side, as in the mockup.
The hat with the star and the plume makes the identity clear in every sprite direction.
issues: The hat is tall and large, like a helmet. The mockup hat is a lower dome. Make the hat lower.
The coat ends at the hips. The mockup coat is long, to the knees, with red lapels. Make the coat longer.
The nose is small. The mockup nose is large and round. Make the nose larger.
The large hat puts the face in shade at 128 px in the side directions.
general.next: Make the hat lower and the coat longer, as in the mockup.
